title: Token Cost Cockpit - portfolio heatgrid, lineage timeline & ratecard scenarios
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a consolidated 'Token Cost Cockpit' view for Redwood Console that combines a portfolio heatgrid (multi-tenant cost hotspots), a token-lineage timeline for attribution, and an interactive ratecard scenario simulator with exportable artifacts. Goal: give platform and finance users a single-pane view to investigate per-route token spend, attribute costs across services and prompts, and run pricing scenario simulations for forecasting and chargeback. Must support very large result sets (thousands of routes) and integrate with the existing exports pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Heatgrid shows cost density by service/route and supports grouping by tag, model, or region
Lineage timeline enables drilling from aggregate to single request trace-level attribution (with KV cache highlights)
Ratecard simulator lets users apply custom price overrides and preview monthly cost projections
Export supports CSV and Parquet schema with per-token breakdown fields documented
Prototype performance targets: initial render < 600ms for 200 rows (client-side lazy loading ok)
Design handoff artifacts (Figma + CSV schema) available and approved by PM and ENG
tasks: Finalize low/hi-fidelity flows for heatgrid and timeline (due 2025-01-18)
Run 5 moderated usability sessions with internal dev/finance reps (complete 2025-01-24)
Add export schema and sample CSV to design spec
Prototype interactive ratecard modal in Figma with scenario presets
Handoff to ENG with annotated component specs and accessibility notes

decisions: Use heatgrid (matrix) as the primary overview visualization with color normalization toggle (absolute vs per-account percent)

Avoid storing full prompt text by default in exports; include hashed sample and opt-in raw-snippet storage behind a privacy toggle
